text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text: Journey, where's Golshi?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
She's not here. She went on a solo trip 
out west to prepare for the end of the 
year.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I heard there was also a plan for her to 
head to the Japan Cup, but...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...The one who will set that stage ablaze 
has already been chosen."

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Today is the Japan Cup! The clash of the 
century begins at Tokyo Racecourse!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
A star-studded lineup competes today! 
Following the Tenno Sho (Autumn), GⅠ 
Umamusume Eishin Flash and Tosen Jordan 
take to the track!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
"And joining them is the indomitable noble 
lady crowned with the glorious Triple 
Tiara, Gentildonna!"

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text: And—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The "World's" Tyrant, Orfevre, enters the 
fray as well!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Just listen to these cheers! Look at this 
incredible fervor!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: WOOOOOOOAAAH! Orfevre--!! My King--!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Even after such a desperate struggle! The 
King has appeared before us once more! 
—Proclaiming that her reign shall 
continue!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Who will seize victory on this historic 
day?! Behold the history in the making at 
the Japan Cup!!

text_block_list.name: Tourist A
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, Orfe's race is about to start! 
Phone, my phone! There was a live stream, 
right?!

text_block_list.name: Tourist B
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Lord Orfevre... So divine, even 
through a screen...!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Lemme see that too, Golshi-chan!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Must be something pretty damn interesting 
over there, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "CASE: Interrogation"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I hold a final strategy meeting with 
Fenomeno before she enters the paddock.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Orfevre-san is a formidable rival! I am 
well aware of that.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
She is a Triple Crown Umamusume who went 
right for the world's throat at the Prix 
de l'Arc de Triomphe. There are very few 
who could ever stand beside her.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However, I am steadily gaining strength 
too!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"Even if I'm up against Orfe-san, I know I 
can put on a run that touches someone's 
heart!"

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Yes! On this very day, I shall set an 
example for the children!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Know your place.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Huh—

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: (UOOOOOOH!)

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: "Orfeee!! Lady Orfe~! Orfevre!!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If you're going to back down, then step 
aside and give up your spot.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Chuckle... Truly a melting pot. It is as 
if the entire world revolves around you.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Gentildonna-san. My peer, and the 
conqueror of the Tiara route...)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Yet did you know? Power changes 
everything."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Common sense. Reputation. Even the object 
of one's devotion.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —It is the strong who change the world.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Foolish.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Dost thou fail to grasp even the simple 
reason why mortals yearn for Us?"

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: The King...

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —My people.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Pray. For my glory.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Desire it. Believe in what you wish to 
believe.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: What lies within that heart—is it...?

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text:
The King...! Lord Orfe...! Lord 
Orfevre...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator
text_block_list.text: It is your victory, Lord Orfevre!!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"Then offer it all up! Place everything 
upon this back!"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Every single one of your dreams belongs to 
this King!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(...I can't take my eyes off it. So this 
is... Orfe-san's...)

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: —I have nothing to give the likes of you.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ngh!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(No! Don't be afraid, don't look down! 
Don't lose your nerve, don't yield, don't 
back down!!)

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Fenomenooo! Do your best!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Kh!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: —Stand and face it.
